item.title: DOZ UP v2.5.0 Released - Ultra-Fast Upload System
item.description: Major update with pre-generated URLs for instant sharing. URLs are ready before you take a photo!

DOZ UP v2.5.0 - Force Update Release

We're excited to announce DOZ UP v2.5.0 with revolutionary features:

  • Ultra-Fast Upload System: Pre-generated URLs for instant sharing

  • Fixed Popup Issues: All windows display properly
  • Performance Boost: Non-blocking saves, parallel processing
